caption: Rebuild your energy #mindfulness #usahealth #mentalhealth #mind #healthy
transcript: My friend, if you feel like this, here are three things you must do. First, put the phone down. The screen does not rest you. It drains the last of what you have left. Second, drink warm water slowly, not coffee, not sugar. Your body is not asking to be pushed harder. It is asking to be met gently. Third, ten minutes of nothing. No task, no noise, no screen. Sit or lie down and let the body fully stop. You are not lazy, my friend. You are not weak. You are simply running on empty and asking, finally, to be filled back up. Follow me and come back tomorrow. We will build your energy back, a little each day.
